title: Week-1 Evaluation Plan for Knee-Friendly Mobility and Joint Strengthening

tests.name: 30-Second Sit-to-Stand Test
tests.how: Sit on a standard chair and stand up fully then sit down as many times as possible in 30 seconds.
tests.targets: Assess lower body strength and knee function.
tests.notes: Use a chair without armrests; keep arms crossed over chest.

tests.name: 2-Minute Step Test
tests.how: March in place lifting knees to midway between knee and hip height for 2 minutes.
tests.targets: Evaluate cardiovascular endurance and lower limb mobility.
tests.notes: Count the number of times the right knee reaches the target height.

tests.name: Comfortable Walk Duration
tests.how: Walk at a comfortable pace on a flat surface for as long as possible up to 10 minutes.
tests.targets: Measure baseline walking endurance without pain.
tests.notes: Record total duration and any knee discomfort.

tests.name: Rate of Perceived Exertion (RPE) Explanation
tests.how: Explain the Borg RPE scale from 6 (no exertion) to 20 (maximal exertion).
tests.notes: Aim for RPE 11-13 (light to somewhat hard) during sessions.

session: Warm-up: 3 minutes gentle marching in place
Mobility: Knee circles (10 each direction, seated or standing)
Strength: Seated leg extensions with self-anchored resistance band (2 sets of 10 reps per leg)
Strength: Standing hamstring curls with resistance band (2 sets of 10 reps per leg)
Cool-down: 3 minutes slow walking and gentle knee bends
Warm-up: 3 minutes slow walking
Cardio: 10 minutes low-impact stepping in place (knee height comfortable)
Mobility: Ankle pumps and circles (2 sets of 15 each)
Cool-down: 3 minutes slow walking and deep breathing
Warm-up: 3 minutes gentle marching
Strength: Side leg lifts with resistance band (2 sets of 10 reps per leg)
Strength: Seated calf raises (2 sets of 15 reps)
Mobility: Seated knee flexion and extension stretches (hold 20 seconds, 2 reps)
Cool-down: 3 minutes slow walking
Goal: Walk at a comfortable pace for 20 minutes outdoors or indoors
Focus on maintaining good posture and comfortable knee movement
Warm-up: 3 minutes gentle marching
Mobility: Hip openers seated (10 reps each side)
Strength: Standing hip abduction with resistance band (2 sets of 10 reps per leg)
Strength: Seated leg presses against resistance band (2 sets of 10 reps)
Cool-down: 3 minutes slow walking and knee stretches
Warm-up: 3 minutes slow walking
Cardio: 12 minutes stepping in place at comfortable pace
Mobility: Ankle and knee circles (2 sets of 15 each)
Cool-down: 3 minutes slow walking and deep breathing
Goal: Walk at a comfortable pace for 20-30 minutes
Focus on knee comfort and posture

log_template.example: Felt good, slight stiffness after session

safety_notes: Avoid any sharp or intense knee pain during exercises. Use self-anchored resistance bands only; do not attach bands to doors or external anchors. Warm-up and cool-down are essential to reduce injury risk. If knee discomfort exceeds 4/10 or worsens, stop exercise and consult a healthcare professional. Maintain good posture during all movements.
